svg.title: B to Branding and Identity Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation: the B becomes the original B and fingerprint visual, then develops into a branding identity system with logo, colors, and applications. The original image has been traced as vector paths.
svg.metadata: 5:3 aspect ratio; 1600 by 960; 6.5-second loop; derived from 02_B_branding.png; no external assets.
